verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a hosted service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only GSA-hosted web pages and APIs that require SAM.gov account API keys and approved System Accounts. Nothing shows a deployable or self-hostable version of SAM.gov, and API data extracts are data access, not self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
